116-4613-6218.easyPrerequisites:
Pheres-Band Tromper doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Kiora's Follower is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
116-4613-6218.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
116-4613-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper using Kiora's Follower's ability by tapping it, untapping another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the other creature using Kiora's Follower's ability by tapping it, untapping Pheres-Band Tromper
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

522-6972-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Melira
When Melira dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

512-1432-6478.easyPrerequisites: Arbor Adherent and Ioreth of the Healing House do not have summoning sickness.
512-1432-6478.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Ioreth of the Healing House and Arbor Adherent, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Ioreth of the Healing House ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-1432-6478.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Arbor Adherent's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

1742-7282-8163.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Karn with haste.
Put the token Karn into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The token Karn's ability triggers, causing you to draw five cards.
Activate Skirge Familiar five times by discarding five cards, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.
1742-7282-8163.notes: The original Karn will count as all five colors for the token Karn's ability, so no other permanents are needed to generate the colors.

2738-3967-4871-6026.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Field of Souls, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Field of Souls trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2653-2893-6664-7906.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the basic land enters, Nissa and Thranduil's Company trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Thranduil's Company trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1563-2079-2457-7824.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

884-3375-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Immortal Sun.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Ayara triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Ayara trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Ayara trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
884-3375-4399-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

1594-1621-5998-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Wight of the Reliquary

2178-5627-7705.easyPrerequisites: Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
2178-5627-7705.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2178-5627-7705.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Wight of the Reliquary triggers, untapping Wight of the Reliquary.
Resolve the Wight of the Reliquary ability from step 1, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Mole Man triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1170-2440-4055-7528.description:
Cast the copy of Awaken the Ages from exile by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten triggers, flickering Strife Scholar, which enters prepared.
When Strife Scholar enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding at least {C}.
Resolve the spell from step 1, creating two 2/2 Spirit creature tokens.
When the tokens enter, Mana Echoes triggers for each of them, adding a total of at least {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Pay an additional {R} to repeat steps 1 through 5 an additional time, this time adding nine {C}.
Activate Energy Refractor by paying {2}, adding one colored mana.
Repeat steps 1 through 5 and step 7 any number of times.

4377-4499-5531.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three Islands.
4377-4499-5531.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons for its buyback cost by paying {4}{U}{U} and sacrificing three Islands, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and return Walk the Aeons to your hand.
Blink Lumra using Emiel the Blessed.
When Lumra enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards and then return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat each turn.

4004-5241-7149.description:
Cast Sakashima's Student by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Sakashima's Student into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Sakashima's Student dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Wormfang Turtle, gaining its abilities.
When Sakashima's Student enters, its first ability triggers, exiling it.
When Sakashima's Student leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Sakashima's Student from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Repeat from step 2.

240-4068-5470-6798.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
240-4068-5470-6798.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, causing you to surveil 1
Repeat from step 2.

1170-1329-1414-4460.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard.
Cast Lotus Petal by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2730-4050-5987.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Angel of Indemnity.
When Angel of Indemnity dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Angel of Indemnity
Repeat.

3755-4871-5147-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
3755-4871-5147-5220.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

1496-4017-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1496-4017-4186.description:
Gain life.
Sunbond triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1491-4474-6702.description:
Activate Kilo by tapping it, adding {1}.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a +1/+1 counter on Kilo.
Activate Kilo by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

4359-6575-6684.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of The First Tyrannic War and then putting two lore counters on it.
The First Tyrannic War token's first, second and third chapter abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger. Then, resolve the second trigger, putting a lore counter on Esper Terra.
Esper Terra's second chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of a nonlegendary enchantment you control.
Resolve the third First Tyrannic War trigger, putting two lore counters on Esper Terra and causing you to sacrifice the First Tyrannic War token.
Esper Terra's third and fourth chapter abilities trigger. Resolve the third ability's trigger, creating a token copy of a nonlegendary enchantment you control.
Resolve the fourth trigger, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

851-1651-2043-6311.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Radiant Lotus that are 1/1 Soldier artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Radiant Lotus tokens, untapping the nontoken Radiant Lotus.
Activate the nontoken Radiant Lotus by tapping it and sacrificing the Radiant Lotus tokens, adding {6}.
Repeat.

927-1165-2861.notablePrerequisites: Archfiend of the Dross has no more than four oil counters on it.
927-1165-2861.description:
Cast Heartless Act by paying {1}{B}, removing up to three oil counters from Archfiend of the Dross.
At the beginning of your end step, Jon Irenicus triggers, giving an opponent control of Archfiend of the Dross.
At the beginning of the opponent's next upkeep, Archfiend of the Dross triggers, causing the opponent to remove an oil counter from it and lose the game.

1537-2440-4183-4720.notablePrerequisites:
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Zealous Conscripts
1537-2440-4183-4720.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Zealous Conscripts with haste.
When the token Zealous Conscripts enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Zealous Conscripts trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Holding priority, if you control less than four creatures that share a creature type with Zealous Conscripts, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Zealous Conscripts for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Stonework Packbeast twice by paying {4}, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

222-413-2018-4871.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee.
When Slimefoot and Squee dies, Luminous Broodmoth and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, returning Slimefoot and Squee from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee.
When Slimefoot and Squee dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 6.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee trigger from step 4, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger from step 2, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Luminous Broodmoth.
When Luminous Broodmoth dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station abilities from steps 1 and 12.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and Luminous Broodmoth from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee and Luminous Broodmoth enter, Slimefoot and Squee triggers once and Blasting Station triggers twice.
Resolve both Blasting Station triggers, untapping it.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

4708-5445-5660.notablePrerequisites: Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to Evolution Witness.
4708-5445-5660.description:
Cast Dark Sphere by paying {0}.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Dark Sphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dark Sphere ability.
Repeat.

283-2113-3812.notablePrerequisites:
Illusionist's Bracers and Karametra's Favor attached to Simic Ragworm.
Simic Ragworm does not have summoning sickness.
283-2113-3812.description:
Activate Simic Ragworm by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Simic Ragworm by paying {U}.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Simic Ragworm's ability.
Resolve the copy of Simic Ragworm's ability, untapping it.
Activate Simic Ragworm by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
 Resolve Simic Ragworm's ability from step 2, untapping it.
Repeat.

703-4313-4772.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it and Flameshadow Conjuring trigger.
Resolve the Astral Dragon trigger, creating four token copies of Doubling Season that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
Resolve the Flameshadow Conjuring trigger, causing you to pay {R} to create a total of 32 Astral Dragon tokens with haste.
When the Astral Dragon tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating an extremely large number of Doubling Season tokens that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.

946-1744-2836-3994.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two other Golems on the battlefield.
946-1744-2836-3994.description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, targeting Precursor Golem.
Precursor Golem's second ability triggers, creating a kicked copy of Rite of Replication targeting every other Golem.
Resolve the first Rite of Replication, creating five token copies of the Golem it is targeting.
If the Golem was Percursor Golem, the Percursor Golem tokens enter the battlefield, triggering their first abilities, creating a total of ten 3/3 Golem artifact creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3 for each other Rite of Replication.
Cast Twisted Image by paying {U}, targeting any Golem.
The six Percursor Golems' second abilities each trigger, creating six copies of Twisted Image targeting every other Golem.
Resolve the first Twisted Image, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat step 8 until you draw from an empty library, causing you to win the game.

660-1866-2882-4999.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Treva's Attendant.
660-1866-2882-4999.description:
Cast Sandbar Merfolk either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {U}, causing it to enter the battlefield as a copy of Treva's Attendant due to Infinite Reflection.
Activate Sandbar Merfolk by paying {1} and sacrificing it, adding {G}{W}{U}.
If you cast Sandbar Merfolk from your graveyard, Sandbar Merfolk is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Infinite Reflection removing Sandbar Merfolk's cycling ability.
Repeat.

376-678-3830-4050.description:
Cast Cubwarden for its mutate cost by paying {W}{W}, targeting a non-Human creature you control.
The Cubwarden mutated creature triggers, creating two 1/1 Cat creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Cubwarden mutated creature, adding {W}.
When the Cubwarden mutated creature dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Cubwarden and any cards merged with it from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Cat token, adding {W}.
Repeat.

2630-4116-4762.notablePrerequisites:
Volrath does not have summoning sickness.
Devoted Druid and Chronatog each have at least one counter on them.
2630-4116-4762.description:
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Devoted Druid until your next turn.
Activate Volrath by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Volrath by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2 one additional time.
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Chronatog until your next turn.
Activate Volrath by paying {0}, causing it to get +3/+3 until end of turn, and causing you to skip your next turn.
Repeat.

738-1306-1646-4647-4659.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls a creature with toughness equal to one.
738-1306-1646-4647-4659.description:
Activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Acorn Catapult by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting a creature an opponent controls with toughness equal to one.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing Mana Crypt and Acorn Catapult, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Acorn Catapult ability, dealing 1 damage to the creature, causing it to die due to having zero toughness, and causing its controller to create a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the opponent's creature dies, Glissa triggers twice, returning Acorn Catapult and Mana Crypt from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Acorn Catapult and Mana Crypt by paying {4}.
Repeat.

4447-4650.notablePrerequisites:
Assault Suit attached to Gorilla Pack.
A player controls no Forests.
4447-4650.description:
If needed, give control of Gorilla Pack to an opponent who controls no Forests.
When Gorilla Pack's controller controls no Forests, Gorilla Pack triggers, causing them to sacrifice it.
However, Gorilla Pack cannot be sacrificed due to Assault Suit.
Gorilla Pack triggers again, creating a mandatory infinite loop that causes the game to end in a draw.

791-1887-2290.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
791-1887-2290.description:
Activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting two +1/+1 counters on Spike Feeder.
Activate Spike Feeder's second ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat.

1628-2034-5189.notablePrerequisites:
Necrosynthesis attached to Ghave.
Ghave has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
1628-2034-5189.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
Necrosynthesis triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Ghave.
Repeat.

2440-3581-3940.notablePrerequisites: Two additional spirits on the battlefield.
2440-3581-3940.description:
Pay {3}{R} to cast Haze of Rage with buyback, giving all your creatures +1/+0 untill end of turn.
Kykar triggers, creating a spirit.
On ETB, the spirit triggers Mana Echoes, generating {3}.
Sacrifice the spirit to Kykar to generate {R}.
Repeat.
